verdict.rationale: Bruno AI lets users describe what they need in natural language. It generates pre-request, post-response and test scripts, writes docs, and builds complete Apps from plain descriptions, and an AI Chat Sidebar takes free-form requests from anywhere in the workspace. External agents (Cursor, VS Code Copilot, Codex via AGENTS.md) can also generate Bruno collections from prompts. Missing for 10: evidence that natural-language commands can drive core operations such as running requests or collections and managing environments (not just generating artifacts or answering questions), no independent or hands-on corroboration, and it depends on the user supplying their own AI provider key.
